page.overview:
Who is Sea Cucumber Devil?

The |Namako no Akuma}} is a devil that embodies the concept of sea cucumbers.

The Sea Cucumber Devil has a cylindrical fleshy body with countless human fingers emerging from all sides. At the top of its body is a large orifice and a human skull which emerges from just underneath it. In the anime, its body is magenta and blue with blue fingers, though the skull remains white.

Nothing is currently known about the Sea Cucumber Devil's personality except it presumably possesses hatred for humans like all non-humanoid devils.

The Sea Cucumber Devil was seen in the city and as it was being reported by Kenzo, Power leaped down from above, and smashed the devil to pieces with her hammer, instantly killing it.
